text:
Aisha: Quick decision needed 	6 finalize beta partner acceptance checklist + launch gates by EOD.
Sam: +1. Hard constraints: 6 partner slots, 4-week beta, max 2 deep integrations per partner.
Neil: Metrics we should track: latency p95, error rate <1%, and primary-prompt quality regression <5%.
Tara: Outreach angle: emphasize 'direct roadmap influence' and 'priority tuning windows' to boost commitment.
Josh: Infra reality: must stagger partner start dates by at least 1 week or KV cache/batching will spike. I'll publish a capacity calendar.
Priya: Legal asks: include anonymization opt-out, KMS confirmation, and explicit no-PHI clause unless approved.
Maya: CS needs a short onboarding playbook + an escalation path template for any regressions.
Aisha: Draft acceptance checklist (short): signed pilot agreement; 5 canonical prompts + baseline outputs uploaded; kickoff calls scheduled (prod + eng); agreed success metrics (1 quantitative + 2 qualitative); weekly 30m sync contact; data/KMS acknowledgement.
Sam: I'll run a simple scoring rubric (impact, implementation effort, data readiness, legal friction) and return top 6 + 2 alternates.
Neil: Eval cadence: weekly automated diffs + human spot checks. Midpoint review at 2 weeks to decide on rollbacks/tuning.
Tara: Outreach copy draft: "Hi <PartnerName>, we'd love to run a short 4-week beta to help shape Redwood inference defaults. Includes prioritized tuning, shared success metrics, and weekly check-ins. Interested?"
Josh: Ops actions: expose per-partner route, token-level cost dashboard, and a soft throttling policy we can adjust during onboarding.
Priya: Add requirement that partners confirm any examples are de-identified or they opt into anonymization for public evals.
Maya: CS handoff: once scored, I'll create onboarding stubs and a weekly sync cadence doc for each partner.
Aisha: Owners: Sam=scoring, Tara=outreach + comms, Josh=capacity calendar + routes, Neil=eval dashboard, Priya=legal/data, Maya=CS/onboarding.
Aisha: If no objections by EOD we publish invites Monday and stagger starts. Please react :thumbsup: if you're good.
